slides.headline: Everyone is reading this leaderboard wrong.
slides.subtext: The score column isn't the one that matters.
slides.label: AI CODING BENCHMARKS 2026
slides.note: Large headline center. Accent green on 'wrong.' Label small top-left in muted. Arrow or swipe hint bottom-right.

slides.headline: Here's the number nobody mentioned.
slides.note: Two rows only, large text. Callout line at bottom in green. Clean table feel, not busy.

slides.headline: Run 100 tasks a day. Here's the bill.
slides.callout: $382,000 extra per year for 1.6% more accuracy.
slides.note: Two-column layout. Green accent on the $382K callout. Bold the annual numbers.

slides.headline: Same model. Different budget.
slides.body: Opus 4.7 runs across 5 tiers. Max, Extra High, High, Medium, Low. Same underlying model. More thinking tokens = higher score = higher cost.
slides.note: 3-row mini table for the tiers. Body text above. Clean and spacious.

slides.headline: You're not buying a smarter model.
slides.body: You're buying the same model with more time to think. You're paying for patience.
slides.note: Large centered text. Headline in white, body in muted. Minimal slide, high contrast.

slides.headline: The Composer anomaly.
slides.body: Third place overall. $0.55 per task. Twenty cents cheaper than Gemini 3.5 Flash, which scores 14 points lower.
slides.note: Three metric tiles across the bottom. Body text above.

slides.headline: Score per dollar. That's the ratio.
slides.body: Capital efficiency. Same question finance asks about every trade.
slides.note: Three rows. Green accent on Composer row. Body text at bottom in muted.

slides.headline: Most tasks don't need the top tier.
slides.body: The builders who figure this out early have systems that actually scale. The ones who don't have expensive demos.
slides.note: Centered layout. Two short paragraphs. White on black. Simple.

slides.headline: Read the cost column.
slides.subtext: That's usually where the actual decision lives.
slides.label: Follow for more from inside finance and AI.
slides.note: Closing slide. Headline large. CTA in green. Label in muted at bottom. Clean.
